key_facts: Twelve tools over JSON-RPC stdio, no dependencies (README.md)
Registered via growmos integrate mcp or a mcpServers snippet (docs/agents.md)
Listed on the MCP Registry as com.codician/growmos (docs/mcp-registry.md)
summary: The MCP server (growmos mcp) is a zero-dependency JSON-RPC stdio server that exposes the graph as twelve tools — context, query, entity, search, remember, link, journal, check, next, apply, status, sample — so any MCP-capable client (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Grok) can use the graph without shelling out. It is registered by growmos integrate mcp (.mcp.json, .cursor/mcp.json) and listed on the official MCP Registry as com.codician/growmos.
